handoff.authority: GitHub records for each repository; this index records placement, not permission to start jobs
handoff.routing: Only actual enabled Actions workflows can execute. A nominal lane owner is not a current running job; B is idle for original research until explicitly admitted.
handoff.oscillation: Record source and target revision, lane, job URL, result, provenance and explicit acceptance before transferring state
handoff.b_privacy: B is currently public. Its GitHub Actions API can be read without login; public source does not prove that B's independent research workflows are activated. If B is made private again, the meta viewer must mark it unavailable rather than displaying zero.
handoff.recovery: Open the shared meta dashboard first. Read both repos' handoff files and GitHub Actions journals. Browser displays public job state; ChatGPT may use the linked accounts to handle separate code/actions.

observation_scope: Public GitHub Actions workflow-run counts sampled periodically; no inferred total job slots, private data or automatic dispatch.
